name: Jehoshabeath
title: The Princess Who Saved the Royal Line
summary: Jehoshabeath (also called Jehosheba) was the daughter of King Joram of Judah and the sister of King Ahaziah. She saved her nephew Joash from being killed by Queen Athaliah, who sought to wipe out the entire royal line. By hiding the young child in the temple for six years, she preserved David's royal lineage.

keyEvents.title: Athaliah's Destruction of the Royal Line
keyEvents.description: After King Ahaziah was killed, his mother Athaliah attempted to wipe out the entire royal family in order to seize power for herself.

keyEvents.title: Jehoshabeath Saves Joash
keyEvents.description: Jehoshabeath took her nephew Joash, who was Ahaziah's son, and hid him along with his nurse in a bedroom so that he would be concealed from Athaliah and not killed.

keyEvents.title: Joash Hidden in the Temple for Six Years
keyEvents.description: For six years, Joash was hidden in the Lord's house while Athaliah ruled over the land. Jehosheba's husband, the priest Jehoiada, ensured that the child was safe.

keyEvents.title: Jehoiada's Coup Against Athaliah
keyEvents.description: In the seventh year, Jehosheba's husband, the high priest Jehoiada, organized a coup in which he crowned the young Joash as king and overthrew Queen Athaliah.

keyEvents.title: Joash Crowned King
keyEvents.description: The seven-year-old Joash was crowned and anointed as king over Judah, and the people rejoiced. David's lineage was preserved thanks to Jehosheba's courageous action.

keyEvents.title: Jehosheba Identified as the Priest's Wife
keyEvents.description: In Chronicles, Jehosheba (Jehoshabeath) is identified as the daughter of King Joram and wife of the priest Jehoiada, which explains her access to the temple.
